objective: Define how filelist-derived hybrid templates must handle source dependency closure after the first materialized-template execution exposed an incomplete source list.

problem_statement.observed_failure: The first non-dry-run materialized filelist template failed at Verilator build because third_party/ITA/src/ita.sv imported ita_package before the generated template listed ita_package/common_cells dependencies.
problem_statement.accepted_repair: The generated template source_files were expanded to include the existing PULP ITA/common_cells source closure before rerunning successfully.
problem_statement.policy_need: Future filelist-facing templates must either receive an explicit complete source closure or identify that source-closure completeness has not been proven before non-dry-run execution.

required_next_gate.name: run_filelist_source_closure_dependency_policy_dry_run_gate
must_validate: dry-run policy text identifies explicit complete source closure as required for execution
dry-run policy text identifies known-template source closure copy as allowed
dry-run policy text records source closure provenance
dry-run policy text records source closure status as complete, incomplete, unknown, or refused
dry-run policy text keeps arbitrary RTL dependency inference as a non-claim
the previously failing ITA leaf-source case remains documented as incomplete until closure is supplied
generated reports and artifacts remain non-canonical

non_claims: not automatic dependency inference for arbitrary RTL
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
